name: moodle-academic
description: Connect your own Moodle account (UFSC and others) to Claude Code: deadlines, assignments, quizzes, grades, attendance, materials, announcements.

moodle_url.title: Moodle URL
moodle_url.description: Base address of your Moodle (https). Default: UFSC Moodle Presencial.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for dates (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo).

mobile_token.title: Moodle token (mobile web service)
mobile_token.description: Create it at <your Moodle>/user/managetoken.php, service 'Moodle mobile web service'. Stored in your system's secure storage, never shown to the model.

attendance_token.title: Attendance token (optional)
attendance_token.description: Only if your Moodle offers an 'Attendance' service on managetoken.php. Leave empty otherwise.

vpl_token.title: VPL token (optional)
vpl_token.description: Only if your Moodle offers a 'VPL web service' on managetoken.php. Leave empty otherwise.

attest_services.title: Services whose token is yours but cannot be proven (optional)
attest_services.description: Comma list, e.g. 'attendance'. Needed when the service hides your user id. You are declaring the token belongs to your own account.

attendance_min_percent.title: Minimum attendance (optional)
attendance_min_percent.description: e.g. 75%. Only fill in if you know the rule for your courses; always check each syllabus.
